name: api-aspnet
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: API with ASP.NET Core
description: A minimal API with ASP.NET Core and C# (.NET 10): OpenAPI, a solution with a test project and integration tests with WebApplicationFactory.

base.command: mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && dotnet new gitignore && dotnet new sln -n Api && dotnet new webapi -o src/Api -n Api && dotnet new xunit -o tests/Api.Tests -n Api.Tests && dotnet sln add src/Api tests/Api.Tests && dotnet add tests/Api.Tests reference src/Api && dotnet add tests/Api.Tests package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing

public partial class Program;

instructions:
## How to work here

- Endpoints in `src/Api/`. Group them per resource in extension methods (`app.MapUsers()`) using `MapGroup`, and return `TypedResults` so OpenAPI knows every response.
- Configuration through `appsettings.json` and the options pattern; secrets with `dotnet user-secrets` locally, never in the repo.
- Register services in `Program.cs` with the right lifetime (scoped for anything holding a DB context).
- Integration tests in `tests/Api.Tests/` with `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` (see `HealthTests.cs`).
- Add packages from the project folder: `cd src/Api && dotnet add package <name>`. Run with `dotnet run --project src/Api`.
- Before finishing: `dotnet build` and `dotnet test`. Needs the .NET 10 SDK.
